sn36.20:1.1: Dve pi mayā bhikkhave vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || tisso pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || pañca pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || cha pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || aṭṭhārasā pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || chattiṃsā pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || aṭṭhasatam pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || || Evam pariyāyadesito bhikkhave mayā dhammo || evam pariyāyadesite kho bhikkhave mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanumaññissanti na samanujānissanti na samanumodissanti || tesam etam pāṭikaṅkham bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññam mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti || || Evam pariyāyadesito bhikkhave mayā dhammo || evam pariyāyadesite kho bhikkhave mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumaññissanti samanujānissanti samanumodissanti || tesam etam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ samaggā samodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññam pīyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharissanti || ||
sn36.20:2.1: Pañcime bhikkhave kāmaguṇā || la || Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam bhikkhave vijjati yam aññātitthiyā paribbājakā evam vadeyyuṃ || Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ Samaṇo Gotamo āha || taṃ ca sukhasmim paññāpeti || tayidaṃ kiṃsu tayidaṃ kathaṃsūti || || Evaṃ vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā || Na kho āvuso Bhagavā sukhaññeva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmim paññāpeti || Yattha yattha āvuso sukham upalabbhati || yamhi yamhi taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmim paññāpetīti || || Rahogatavaggo dutiyo ||
sn36.20:3.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Rahogataṃ dve Ākāsaṃ || Agāraṃ dve ca Santakam || Aṭṭhakena ca dve vuttā || Pañcakaṅgo ca Bhikkhunā ti || ||
